map.输入样本均值、样本量与已知的总体标准差，检验样本均值是否偏离给定的假设值，输出: Enter the sample mean, sample size and known population standard deviation to test whether the sample mean deviates from the hypothesized value, outputting the Z statistic with two-sided and one-sided p values, for significance testing of the mean when the population standard deviation is known.
map.填写「总体标准差 σ」。: Enter the population standard deviation sigma.
map.σ 已知时检验均值：z=(x̄−m0)/(σ/√n)。: Testing the mean with sigma known: z = (x_mean - m0)/(sigma/sqrt(n)).
map.大样本近似也常用。: The large-sample approximation is also commonly used.
map.：n=100：z=5/(15/10)=3.333，p≈0.0009，高度显著。: With n=100: z = 5/(15/10) = 3.333, p is about 0.0009, highly significant.
map.z 和 t 检验结果差异？: Why do z and t test results differ?
map.σ 已知/大样本用 z 偏宽松；σ 未知小样本用 t 更保守，差异随 n 增大而: When sigma is known or the sample is large, z is somewhat lenient; when sigma is unknown and the sample is small, t is more conservative, and the difference vanishes as n grows.
map.默认双尾（检验\"是否相等\"）；若有方向假设（>或<）用单尾，p 减半。: Two-tailed by default (testing "are they equal"); with a directional hypothesis (> or <) use one-tailed and p halves.
